- A different rate: type it, and Differs from the rate sheet asks for the reason. The rental is not added without it. Empty the field to take the sheet's rate again.
- The review screen of a request or an offer does the same when you choose Bill to and the insurer: the rate follows the insurer chosen, and a rate typed that differs needs the reason.
- An insurer with no rate for the car: type the rate the adjuster authorized, as before.
- The booking's Insurance replacement card (Overview and Money tabs) shows the insurer and the claim, the daily rate and where it comes from, Differs with the reason when it is not the sheet's, the caps, the days covered, what the insurer pays and its invoices.

## Invoices to the insurer

- **Draft insurer invoice** on the booking bills the insurer at the booking's daily rate (the sheet's, or the one typed with its reason) for the days authorized.
- The weekly cap and the cap for 30 days lower the amount of a long rental. Billed for the rental only, the insurer also pays delivery and pickup up to its allowance; billed for everything, delivery and pickup above the allowance are the renter's.
- The invoice line says the rate and where it comes from (for example at $65.00 a day, Example Mutual rate sheet, Sedan), and the PDF prints the taxes note. Send it and record its payments in Money > Insurer invoices, as before.

## Billing history

**Money** > **Insurer rates**, then the insurer's name.

1. The tiles: bookings, days used and authorized, billed, paid, outstanding, the average daily rate and the days the insurer takes to pay (from sent to paid).
2. Rates by class (Set, Change and End work here too), then the History of the rates: each rate with its dates, its status, why it changed and who saved it.
3. Billing by class: for each class the bookings, days authorized and used, billed, paid, outstanding, the average rate and the days to pay.
4. Bookings: each booking with its class, claim, dates, days, rate (Sheet and the reason when it differs), what was billed, paid and outstanding, and its invoices (each opens its PDF).
5. Choose Picked up from and to and press **Show** for a period. **Download CSV** saves the bookings of the period for a spreadsheet.

sections.title: Chauffeur service
sections.blurb: Chauffeur requests: quote, confirm and close them; the vehicles and their hourly rates.
sections.body_md:
Visitors book a driver and a luxury car or van by the hour on carmacars.ca/chauffeur. The vehicles come from a partner's chauffeur price guide, each with a rate for 2 hours and a rate for 3 hours or more.

:::flow
Request | The visitor sends the date, hours and addresses
Quote | You check with the partner and send the quote
Confirm | The client agrees and pays
Done | Mark it completed after the trip
:::

## The requests

**Bookings** > **Chauffeur**. Each request has its number (CH-1001 and up), the vehicle, the date and start time, the hours, the pickup and drop-off addresses, the passengers, the occasion and the notes.

1. The **Quote** column is the price for the client: the hours at the 2-hour rate (exactly 2 hours) or the 3+ hour rate (3 hours or more), before HST, then HST and the total. The line under it is the quote line to send.
2. **Partner, CarmaCars** shows the partner's sheet amount, what the partner is owed (the sheet amount less the cut) and what CarmaCars keeps (the markup plus the cut).
3. Check the vehicle and the driver with the partner for that time. To change the vehicle or the hours, press **Change**: the quote is worked out again.
4. Send the quote line by email or phone, then press **Quoted** and say how you sent it. The task in the queue is done.
5. When the client agrees, take the payment (a payment link, or at pickup), press **Confirm** and note how it is paid.
6. After the trip press **Completed**. **Decline** or **Cancel** closes a request with the reason.

> Tip: To do has a line **Chauffeur requests to quote** while any request is new, and the card Chauffeur today lists the confirmed trips of the day.

## The vehicles and their rates

**People** > **Partners** > the partner, card Chauffeur vehicles.

1. Each vehicle shows the partner's rates an hour and the client's (the markup added, rounded to the nearest dollar).
2. Press **Edit** to change a rate, give it its own markup or cut, change the passengers, or take it off the site.
3. A vehicle the partner also rents (chauffeur / rental) links to its car pages on the public page.

> Good to know: Booking requests for cars, offers and payments do not cover chauffeur trips: a chauffeur request is a quote that you send and confirm here.

sections.title: Owners and onboarding
sections.blurb: Applications, the terms and first invoice, adding a car for an owner, an owner's terms and invoices, paid and signed, and Forms C and D.
sections.body_md:
Owners apply on the site with List your car. Every application waits for you in one place, Applications: approve it, ask the owner for something, or decline it. Approved owners sign and pay in their portal.

## Applications

**People** > **Applications**. Every owner application, newest first.

1. The chips filter by status: New, Waiting on owner, Approved, Declined, or All. New applications also show on To do.
2. Each row shows the application number, the owner, the car, how many of the four checks are done, and when they applied.
3. Open an application to decide.

![](/guides/img/admin-33-applications-desktop-152f9e34.jpg "desktop; size: 1440 640; address: carmacars.ca/admin/applications; pins: 1 36.8 39.7, 2 48.6 53.1, 3 19.8 53.1")

## Decide on an application

One page holds everything: the owner, the car, the uploads, the four checks and the notes.

1. Check the driver's licence, the ownership, the insurance and the lender or lessor. Mark each one Checked, fine, Problem or Not needed.
2. Press **Approve**. The step "Terms and first invoice" opens for each car, filled in with the owner's negotiated terms (or the standard grid): Insurance Fee, Tracker Fee, management fee (Revenue Share), Install Fee and the first and last month amount (2 x the Insurance Fee unless you type an exact amount). Change any of them to the cent; with several cars, **Use these terms for every car** copies the first car's numbers to the others.
3. Choose the invoices: First and last month, Registration fee (any exact amount), Tracker install (only once trackers are available) and Another invoice. For each one choose Send now, Save as draft or Already paid. Already paid asks how (e-Transfer, cash, cheque, bank transfer or other), the date and the reference: it is recorded like Record payment and the owner gets the receipt, not an invoice.
4. Press **Approve** at the bottom of the step. Nothing is set or sent before that. The owner becomes active, the documents open for one signature in their portal, only the invoices you chose are made, and the owner gets one email.
5. Missing something? Press **Ask for something**, tick what you need (for example the ownership permit or the insurance slip), add a message if you like, and press **Send to the owner**. The owner gets an email and a task in their portal; the application shows Waiting on owner until they answer.
6. Not a fit? Press **Decline**, write the Reason the owner reads, and press **Decline the application**. The owner is emailed for each car.

![](/guides/img/admin-34-application-desktop-98b64f92.jpg "desktop; size: 1440 812; address: carmacars.ca/admin/applications/c324ef8d-ad00-4bcc-bf04-ca68628a26b4; pins: 1 72.9 67.1, 2 73.9 42.9, 3 84.7 42.9, 4 72.9 49.6")

The application has an Invoices tab: every invoice of its cars, drafts and voids included. An application staff entered for the owner says "Entered by staff" and who; approving it sends the owner the set-up email (review the details and sign) instead of the approval email.

> Tip: Notes on the page are for staff only: **Add note** keeps a line on the record. When the owner answers a request, their answer is in the notes and the application is New again.

## Add a car for an owner

**People** > **Add a car for an owner**, or **Add another car** on an owner's page. The owner never has to fill in the application.

1. The owner: find them by name, email or phone, or choose New owner and enter the name, email, phone and address.
2. The car: type the VIN. The car is looked up at once and shown in one line (Edit if something is wrong); no VIN at hand, add it by its plate with the year, make and model from the lists. Tap the colour, check the class, then the odometer, insurer and whether it is owned, financed or leased. Photos are optional: the listing shows sample photos until real ones are added. Upload the ownership permit, the insurance slip and the lender's information if you have them.
3. Terms and first invoice: the same fields as Approve. For another car of the same owner they start from that owner's terms, or their other car's; change them for this car.
4. Who sourced the owner: Entered for CarmaCars, or I sourced this owner (only then are you recorded as the one who brought the owner). How the owner signs: by email, or on paper.
5. Press **Add the car and set it up**. The owner gets one email: review the details, correct anything, and sign. An owner with no sign-in gets the link to choose a password in that same email.

Customer service and fleet assistants add cars the same way from their portal; theirs wait in Applications for you, with the terms and invoices they proposed already filled in. On an approved application staff entered, **Send the set-up email again** sends the owner the email with a fresh link.

## Owners

**People** > **Owners**. Every owner, with their cars and where onboarding stands.

1. Each owner shows their application, how many cars, and where onboarding stands.
2. **View as (owner portal)** shows their portal. **Send password link** helps them sign in.
3. Invite an owner on file: fill in Name and Email under Invite an owner, then press **Send invitation**.

![](/guides/img/admin-12-owners-desktop-3a54d505.jpg "desktop; size: 1440 560; address: carmacars.ca/admin/owners; pins: 1 41.0 42.9, 2 37.4 49.3, 3 77.4 82.5")

The owner signs everything at once in their portal (Check and sign: the agreements, schedules and Forms A and B; the official registry forms are printed and signed in ink). The confirmations to tick, then one signature: CarmaCars countersigns at the same moment, under the signing officer's standing authorization. A car with a second owner on the ownership waits for that owner too: they get their own link by email and sign the same documents.

## Mark a car insured (Insurer confirmed)

A program owner's car is handed over to a renter only once the insurer confirms in writing that it is on the fleet policy. Requests, offers and payment never wait for it.

1. Each car waiting for the insurer is a line on To do: "Insurer has not confirmed : mark it insured". It says Now when a booking picks the car up soon.
2. When the insurer's email arrives, press **Mark insured**. The date is today; change it to the date of the insurer's email if it was earlier. Add its subject as the Reference if you like, and press **Insurer confirmed**.
3. One email for several cars? Press **Mark several insured** on the line " cars wait for the insurer". Every waiting car is ticked: untick any car the insurer did not name, check the date, and confirm them all at once.
4. The same button is on the car: Overview (**Insurer confirmed**) and the Listing tab's checklist, item "Not on the fleet insurance policy yet".

The car is then on the fleet policy from that date: it can be handed over, its Enrollment Date is that date, its fee terms start, and the owner gets the email "Written confirmation: your car is on the fleet policy". Its paperwork (agreements, registry visit, tracker) stays on its checklist until done. A car already listed and Available stays Available.

## Owners who paid another way, and the terms you agreed

Two lines on To do keep an owner's money right without opening their page.

1. "Record the first and last month paid by ": their first and last month invoice was voided and nothing paid is recorded. Press **Record what they paid**, type the amount for each car (tax included), or one total for several cars, how and when it was paid and the reference. A draft first and last month invoice is kept or voided, your choice. Each car's invoice is then marked paid, the owner gets the receipt and the two prepaid months count. Never for a shareholder.
2. "Enter the terms agreed with ": their cars still use the standard grid. Press **Enter the terms**: the Management fee (Revenue Share), the Insurance Fee, the Tracker Fee, the Install Fee and the first and last month are filled in from the grid. Type what you agreed for the owner, and open a car to give it its own. A car whose schedule is signed gets an updated schedule for the owner to sign.
3. Nothing to change? Press **Not needed** or **These are correct**: the line does not come back.

## A shareholder's own car

On the owner's page, each car has **Shareholder’s own car**.

1. A shareholder's own car is split 90/10 (the share in Program settings) and pays no Insurance Fee, Tracker Fee, first and last month or tracker install.
2. Press **Shareholder’s own car**, say why (it is kept in the audit log) and confirm. Press it again to undo. Bookings already made keep their split.
3. A first and last month or a tracker install invoice is refused for such a car, from any screen.

## Cancellation refunds

**Settings** > **Program**: the refund for each cancellation tier.

| When the renter cancels | Refund (default) |
| --- | --- |
| Within 24 hours of booking, 48 hours or more before the start | 95% |
| 48 hours or more before the start | 75% |
| 24 to 48 hours before the start | 50% |
| Under 24 hours, or after the start | 0% |

## An owner's page

Open an owner from Owners. Three tabs: Overview, Terms and Invoices. **Add another car** and **New invoice** sit under the name.

1. Cars and terms, at the top: each car's Insurance Fee, Tracker Fee, management fee (Revenue Share), Install Fee and mode, with **Edit** and History (see An owner's terms, car by car).
2. Upfront invoices: issue the first and last month amount agreed on each car's terms, for each car whose terms are set.
3. Owner: address, sign-in, agreements, and what is still missing for the registry forms.
4. Statements and payouts for this owner.
5. Forms C and D, with a link to the review queue.
6. Further down: **View as (owner portal)**, **Send password link** and **Send a sign-in link to the owner portal**.

![](/guides/img/admin-13-owner-desktop-819a9f8b.jpg "desktop; size: 410 1030; address: carmacars.ca/admin/owners/50a834dc-270a-4c26-b79e-6396fa7bf2e1; pins: 1 24.6 4.4, 2 16.1 32.9, 3 31.5 73.2, 4 21.2 98.1")

## An owner's terms, car by car

The table Cars and terms, at the top of an owner's page and its Terms tab: each car's Insurance Fee and Tracker Fee a month, management fee (Revenue Share), Install Fee and Management Mode, and since when they apply.

1. Press **Edit** on a car's row. The row becomes fields: type the exact amounts (to the cent; the management fee in %). Before the Vehicle Schedule is signed you can also change the Install Fee, the Management Mode and the Onboarding Method.
2. Press **Review**. It lists each value before and after, and what happens to each one. Nothing is saved yet.
3. Not signed yet (or not approved yet): **Save** applies the numbers at once. An unsigned Vehicle Schedule is made again with them, so the owner signs these numbers; a car not approved yet keeps them for the Approve step.
4. Signed: a lower amount is in force from today, or the date you choose under Lower amounts from. No notice period is needed because it only lowers what the owner pays. A lower management fee does this while Settings > Program, Lower management % without owner signature, is on (the default); off, the owner signs an updated Vehicle Schedule first.
5. Signed: a higher Insurance Fee or Tracker Fee needs 30 days' written notice (Enrollment Agreement 4.8). Choose the date under Higher amounts from (30 days ahead at the earliest) and write the Reason: the owner reads it.
6. Signed: a higher management fee (Revenue Share) needs the same notice and the owner's signature. The owner is emailed the notice and an updated Vehicle Schedule to sign; it applies from the date once signed, or from the day they sign if that is later. Higher fees in the same change apply from the date by the notice either way.
7. Press **Confirm**. The owner is emailed the written notice, which is also a PDF in their portal and in the car's History.

History, under each car, lists every period of terms (from, to, the amounts, and why: the Vehicle Schedule, a written notice, lowered) and every change with its notice. A change that has not started yet has Cancel (give the reason): the terms before it run on. An updated schedule waiting for the owner has Record signed on paper (with the date) and Withdraw it. One change at a time: cancel or finish the one waiting before making the next.

The same editor is on the car's page (Records tab, Owner terms). The owner's default terms (for cars whose terms are set later) and the first and last month invoice stay on the Terms tab.

> Good to know: Invoices follow the dates: a month whose Insurance Fee or Tracker Fee changes part way is billed per day at each rate. The Revenue Share of a rental is the one in force on the day it is booked.

## Change a signed car's Management Mode

Managed, Self-Managed or Turo-Only, from a date, for a car whose Vehicle Schedule is signed. An Admin only.

1. Open the owner's Cars and terms table (or the car's page) and press **Change mode** on the car's row.
2. Choose the **New Management Mode** and its Onboarding Method (the options that fit how the car is held), the date under **From**, and write the Reason: the owner reads it. Tick **The owner asked for this** only when it is their own request.
3. Press **Review**: it lists each value before and after (a Self-Managed car has no management fee; a Turo-Only car has no Fees and leaves the fleet insurance policy) and says whether the owner has to sign. Nothing is saved yet.
4. The owner asked and no amount goes up: no signature and no notice period. From today (or the date you chose) the car has the new mode, an updated Vehicle Schedule is issued with CarmaCars' signature and the owner is emailed the notice.
5. Anything else (CarmaCars' own decision, or a higher fee): the owner is emailed the notice and an updated Vehicle Schedule to sign, the date is at least 30 days away and the car stays as it is until it is signed. In History, **Record signed on paper** or **Withdraw it**.
6. A change dated ahead applies by itself on its date: the schedule is issued and the car moves. **Cancel** in History (give the reason) stops it and emails the owner that their terms stay as they are. The same email goes when a notice of a higher fee is cancelled.

> Good to know: A shareholder-owned car has fixed terms. A car whose schedule is not signed yet changes its mode in the terms editor, where it applies at once.

## Paid and signed

**People** > **Paid and signed**. What each owner still has to pay or sign, and how each item was done.

1. Each owner shows how many items are open and how many are done. Owners with nothing left are hidden; press Show every owner to see them.
2. Open **Checklist and quick actions**. Each line says Signed in the portal, Signed on paper, Paid by e-Transfer, Not signed, and so on.
3. Paid by e-Transfer, cheque, cash or bank transfer? Press **Record payment**. Choose Paid by, the Date received and the Reference (the cheque number for a cheque). Leave Amount empty for the full balance, or type less for a partial payment. Add a photo of the cheque or a screenshot if you have one.
4. Signed on paper? Press **Record paper signature**. Choose the Document, check Signed by and Date signed, add the witnesses where the form needs them, and upload the scan of every signed page.
5. The same checklist sits at the top of each owner's page.
6. You rarely need to come here: an upfront or overdue owner invoice is a line on To do with **Record payment**, and an owner whose documents were sent two days ago or more and are not signed is a line with **Record paper signature**. Both pop-ups are the same forms, filled in.

A recorded payment marks the invoice paid (or partly paid), stops the automatic debit for that amount, sends the owner a receipt, and shows "Paid by e-Transfer on " in their portal. A paper signature counts as signed everywhere: the checklist, onboarding and the owner portal. The scan is kept privately with the owner's documents.

> Watch out: Recorded the wrong thing, or a cheque bounced? Press **Void** beside it and give the reason. The invoice owes that amount again and the owner is told; a voided signature makes the item open again. Only an Admin can void.

## Forms C and D

**People** > **Owner forms**. Form C is signed on screen in the owner portal, with the witness on the same screen. Form D (and Form C on paper, if the owner prefers) is printed, signed in front of witnesses, and sent as a photo of each page.

1. Each row shows the owner, the form, the witnesses and when it was uploaded.
2. Press Open to read the photo or scan. Check each marked spot is signed or initialled.
3. Press **Approve**, or **Send back** with What to fix (the owner reads this).

![](/guides/img/admin-22-owner-forms-desktop-c20ad300.jpg "desktop; size: 1440 470; address: carmacars.ca/admin/owner-forms; pins: 1 29.2 52.3, 2 57.6 52.3, 3 76.7 52.3")

sections.title: Owner money
sections.blurb: Owner invoices (drafts, void and reissue, credit notes), the automatic debit, statements, payouts and the company statement.
sections.body_md:
Owner fee invoices are issued on the notice day and debited on the 15th. Invoices of any amount are made by hand, as drafts first. Statements are built, approved and issued each month, and payouts follow.

## Owner invoices

**Money** > **Owner invoices**. Every owner invoice, drafts and voids included. The same list is on each owner's and each application's Invoices tab.

1. Filter by Drafts, Open, Partly paid, Paid, Failed, In arrears or Void, or search by invoice number or owner. Open an invoice to see everything about it.
2. **New invoice** makes an invoice of any amount for an owner's car, for example a registration fee of $123.45.
3. The monthly run and tracker invoices: **Run the monthly invoices** issues the invoices for the 15th by hand, for a missed month (never twice); **Issue all tracker invoices** bills the Tracker Install for each car waiting for its tracker.

![](/guides/img/admin-14-owner-invoices-desktop-dc4ed1f1.jpg "desktop; size: 1440 1060; address: carmacars.ca/admin/invoices; pins: 1 83.3 22.4, 2 41.7 35.7, 3 29.0 43.4")

## Make, edit and issue an invoice

A new invoice is a draft: the owner sees nothing and it is never debited until you issue it.

1. Choose the car, a title (for example Registration fee) and, if you like, the due date (empty: 7 days after it is issued). Each line: the description, the quantity, the unit amount to the cent, HST on or off, and a note. **Add a line** for more.
2. **Save as draft** to come back to it, or **Save and issue** to send it now. On a draft's page, **Issue and email** sends it.
3. Paid another way? Press **Record payment** on the invoice. The page lists the payments with their receipts, the automatic debits, the emails sent and the history.
4. **Resend email** sends the invoice again. **PDF** opens it as a PDF.

## Correct an issued invoice

An issued invoice is never edited. You void it and issue a corrected one.

1. Press **Void**, write the reason (the owner reads it), keep Make a corrected invoice from it ticked, and press **Void the invoice**. Its scheduled debit is cancelled and the owner is told.
2. The corrected invoice opens as a draft with the same lines. Fix the amounts and press **Save and issue**.
3. Already paid? Void the payment first, or press **Credit note** for the amount to give back: it gets its own number and the owner sees it.

Invoices issued before October 20, 2026 at the old default (for example $904.00, or $1,017.00 when the Insurance Fee was $450.00) are not changed by themselves. Where an owner agreed another amount, void them and reissue at the agreed amount.

## The automatic debit

The debit runs by itself. Your job is to watch for returned debits and owners without a mandate.

:::flow
Notice day | Invoices issued, one notice per owner, 10 days before
Debit day | The 15th from 6:00: one debit per invoice
Cleared | The invoice is paid
Returned, insufficient funds | The $50.00 Late Fee is added once; the same amount is tried again within 30 days
Returned for another reason | No retry and no Late Fee: the debit pauses and you get a task
:::

1. The tiles show the next debit day and notice day, scheduled, processing, cleared and returned debits.
2. How it runs explains the policy in words, read from Program settings.
3. Scheduled and processing lists each debit. **Pause** holds one (a reason is needed).
4. Owners lists each mandate. Use **Pause**, **Resume** or **Send a notice now**.

![](/guides/img/admin-15-owner-debits-desktop-f65f061a.jpg "desktop; size: 1440 920; address: carmacars.ca/admin/debits; pins: 1 21.8 21.7, 2 21.5 35.5, 3 91.5 75.4, 4 84.7 94.7")

5. Results: each debit, cleared or returned, with the bank's reason.
6. Run log: each notice and debit run, with its counts.
7. Notices sent: who was told what, for which debit day.

![](/guides/img/admin-15-owner-debits-desktop-8d4682bc.jpg "desktop; size: 1230 520; address: carmacars.ca/admin/debits; pins: 5 11.0 14.4, 6 10.2 52.3, 7 15.4 89.8")

Insufficient funds: the $50.00 Late Fee is added to that invoice once and collected with the owner's next debit, and the original amount is tried again within 30 days, as section 4.4 of the Enrollment Agreement sets out. The retry is never more than the original amount. Returned again: the invoice is in arrears and you get a task.

> Watch out: Returned for any other reason (account closed, payment stopped, no authorization): there is no retry and no Late Fee. The owner's debit pauses, the owner gets an email asking them to fix the account or pay another way, and you get a task. A debit is never more than its notice said. An owner with no mandate gets an email on the notice day and you get a task; nothing is debited for them.

## Owner statements

**Money** > **Owner statements**

1. Press **Build all for a month** (or **Build one**).
2. Open each draft. Check it, **Rebuild** after a correction, **Preview PDF**, then **Approve**.
3. Press **Issue to the owner**. **Reissue** sends a corrected copy; **CSV** exports it.

![](/guides/img/admin-16-statements-desktop-43a313ea.jpg "desktop; size: 1440 400; address: carmacars.ca/admin/statements; pins: 1 79.9 27.3")

![An approved statement: the owner gets it by email with the PDF on the 10th, and payouts follow under Payouts.](/guides/img/admin-17-statement-desktop-106ee57f.jpg "desktop; size: 1440 520; address: carmacars.ca/admin/statements/2eedf660-50ce-4bd9-86d6-01bbe149c000; pins: 3 86.0 22.7")

## Staff commissions

**Money** > **Staff commissions**. Nothing is paid automatically.

:::flow
Not earned yet | The rental is ahead, or not paid in full
Pending approval | Completed and paid in full; a Sales month once it has ended
Approved | You approved it; the staff member is told
Paid | You recorded the payment; the staff member is told
Reversed | Cancelled, refunded or charged back; after payment it comes off the next payment
:::

1. By person shows each staff member's month (Sales: rental days of 100 and the tier), what is not earned yet, pending approval, approved and paid.
2. Press **Approve** on a person (everything that may be approved now) or on one commission.
3. Press **Record a payment**: choose how it was paid (e-Transfer, bank transfer, Wise, cash, the monthly pay statement or another way), the reference and the date.
4. **Prices to review** lists prices typed by hand; **Sourcing claims** lists staff who say they sourced a website request; **Payments made** lists each payment.

|  | Commission |
| --- | --- |
| Sales | By rental days of the month: under 50 days 10%, from 50 days 15%, from 100 days 20%, on all that month's rentals |
| Customer service, finance, fleet, field staff | 10% (also the field referral fee) |
| Base | The rental charge before tax, after discounts, with late extra days; never delivery, kilometres, add-ons or anything else bought. Only a refund of the rental charge comes off |
| On the owner statement | An owner's car: deducted with the kickbacks before Owner Revenue, its own line on the statement. A partner's car: from CarmaCars' commission. A CarmaCars-owned car: a CarmaCars expense |

> Tip: A commission that changes after an owner statement was built (a refund, or the month's Sales tier) goes on the owner's next statement as an adjustment line.

## Field pay

**Money** > **Field pay**. Field staff clock in and out on their phones (My hours); you run the pay every two weeks. Nothing is paid automatically.

:::flow
Clocked in and out | Field staff press Clock in and Clock out; Fleet or you fix a forgotten clock-out
Pay run started | Hours times the hourly rate, plus the approved commissions
Approved | The figures are frozen, the period's hours are locked, the statements are numbered
Paid | You recorded how each person was paid; they get their statement by email
:::

1. The tab **Pay run** shows the current two-week period (Sunday to Saturday: the first day is Settings > Program, Field pay). **Earlier period** and **Later period** move between periods.
2. After the period ends, press **Start the pay run**: one line for each person with hours times their hourly rate, plus the staff commissions and referral fees approved by the end of the period (see Staff commissions). **Refresh the figures** takes in a change made since.
3. Press **Approve**. The period's hours are locked, each line gets a statement number and the figures are frozen. Someone still clocked in blocks it: fix their shift under **Hours** first. **Withdraw** takes an approved run back while no payment is recorded.
4. Press **Record payment** on a line: choose e-Transfer, bank transfer or cash, the reference (not needed for cash) and the date. The commissions in the line are marked paid and the person gets their pay statement by email (**Send again** repeats it). The statement's number opens its PDF; **CSV** gives the run for your accountant.
5. **Hours** lists everyone's shifts of the period. **Add hours** enters a shift for someone who forgot to clock in, **Change** fixes one and **Remove** takes one out. Each needs a reason and is kept in a log. Fleet does the same under Field hours but sees no pay.
6. **Hourly rates** shows each person's rate: CA$18.00 an hour unless you give them their own with **Set the rate** (a reason is needed). A pay run keeps the rate it was started with.

|  | Field pay |
| --- | --- |
| Overtime | Off. Settings > Program, Field pay: pay overtime, after 44 hours in a week, at 150% of the rate |
| Vacation pay | Off. Settings > Program, Field pay: vacation pay (Ontario: 4%) adds that share of wages, overtime and commissions to each statement |
| Deductions | None are worked out: income tax, CPP, EI and the employer's contributions are for your accountant. Each statement says so |
| Commissions that net to nothing | A person whose approved commissions add up to nothing or less (a clawback) is not paid them this period: they carry to the next |

> Tip: A shift of more than 16 hours (a setting) is refused, and so are hours that overlap another shift of the same person. The field staff member sees their hours and statements under My hours on their phone.

## Company statements

CarmaCars' own monthly statement, in twelve sections.

1. Choose the month. The tiles show revenue, fees, refunds, expenses and the company net.
2. Switch between Total, Per owner and Per vehicle.
3. Download **PDF**, **PDF by owner** or **PDF by vehicle**, or press **Email me the PDFs**.
4. **Finalize** freezes the month. **Rebuild** works until then.

![](/guides/img/admin-18-company-statements-desktop-8e2738ed.jpg "desktop; size: 1440 760; address: carmacars.ca/admin/reports; pins: 1 20.8 28.0, 2 19.4 59.3, 3 77.1 15.5, 4 46.9 15.5")

sections.title: Tolls and tickets
sections.blurb: The work queue, reading a notice, checking its lines and charging the right person.
sections.body_md:
Toll notices and tickets arrive by mail and email. Read them into the system, check each line against the notice, and the matching, charges and emails follow.

## The work queue

**Money** > **Tolls and tickets**

1. Filter the queue: Unmatched, Needs review, Matched not charged, Owner not billed, Staff, Charged not notified, Disputed.
2. Each toll shows its notice, kind, issuer, plate, when, amount and who it was matched to.
3. Add one by one with **Log one**, then **Save and match**. **Import a CSV** takes a statement file.

![](/guides/img/admin-19-tolls-desktop-baa198d0.jpg "desktop; size: 1440 500; address: carmacars.ca/admin/tolls; pins: 1 31.6 32.6, 2 59.7 52.0, 3 85.8 21.8")

## Inside a toll

1. Open a toll from the queue. Decide who pays: **Charge the renter**, **Bill to the owner** or **CarmaCars pays**.
2. Wrong notice? Press **Dispute**. Finance can also press **Match again**.
3. Reading profiles (top right on Read a notice) teach the reader an issuer's layout. Paste a notice's text under "Try it" to test one.

## Read a notice

1. Press **Read a notice**. Choose the file: a PDF, a photo (JPEG or PNG) or a CSV, under 15 MB.
2. Leave Reading profile on finding it from the text, or choose the issuer.
3. Press **Read it**. The file is stored first, then read in your browser.
4. Notices read lists every read with its status and counts.

![](/guides/img/admin-20-tolls-read-desktop-d733b5f1.jpg "desktop; size: 1440 760; address: carmacars.ca/admin/tolls/read; pins: 1 25.8 41.2, 2 36.1 52.2, 3 21.0 59.3, 4 25.8 79.7")

## Check the lines and import

1. The notice is on the left (**Zoom**, **Open the file**). The lines are on the right.
2. Check each line beside the notice: kind, issuer, notice number, plate, date and time, amount, fees, due date.
3. Fix what was read wrong, then press **Checked against the notice**. **Leave out** skips a line; **Put it back** returns it.
4. Press **Save as checked**, then **Confirm and import**.

![](/guides/img/admin-21-tolls-review-desktop-c59d0a1c.jpg "desktop; size: 1440 1150; address: carmacars.ca/admin/tolls/read/76f10bea-9140-487b-89c8-a5cc8f15b59b; pins: 1 42.6 16.8, 2 56.7 43.8, 3 90.3 60.9, 4 76.0 38.0")

> Tip: Renters matched with high confidence are charged at import, with the notice and the administration fee, when "Charge renters matched with high confidence now" is ticked. Other lines go to the work queue or stay as exceptions with the reason.

sections.title: Live visitors and live chat
sections.blurb: Who is on the site now, how likely each visitor is to book and why, one-click actions, follow-ups, interest per car, the chat inbox.
sections.body_md:
See who is on the site right now and what they look at, with buying signals, and answer the live chat. The CarmaCars assistant answers the chat first; you take over whenever you want, and it hands over by itself for complaints, damage, payments and anything it should not answer.

## Live visitors

Visitors who accepted analytics (or got the notice in Canada outside Quebec and the US), known customers on their own booking pages and anyone in a chat.

1. Open **Today** > **Live visitors**. "Live now" counts who is on the site now (seen in the last 5 minutes; an open page says it is still there every 45 seconds, so someone reading one page stays on the list). "Visitors today" counts people, with their visits below. The other tiles count hot visitors now, known customers now and chats today. The menu shows how many hot visitors are on the site.
2. Visitors who chose necessary cookies only are never recorded: a line under the tiles says how many chose that today. Closing the tab takes a visitor off the list at once.
3. Each visitor shows a booking likelihood from 0 to 100, with Hot (60 or more), Warm (30 or more) or Cold. The list is sorted by it; choose "Most recent" in Sort, or tick "Hot and warm only".
4. "Why" gives the three strongest reasons, for example "Pickup tomorrow · Reached step 3 of the request form · Tapped to call". The badges are all the signals of the visit; the dots say how strong each is.
5. Each visitor also shows their name when known (signed in, or arrived from one of our emails), otherwise "Visitor from Toronto, phone"; the page and car they are on, and how many others look at that car now; the device, city, the site or campaign that sent them and "from an ad".
6. Suggested: the best next step and the message to send. Press **Invite to chat with this message** to send it at once, **Edit the message** to change it first, **Offer a 10% discount code**, **Assign to Sales** or, when their dates are taken, **Suggest a similar free car**.
7. Press **Pages** for every page and event of the visit with each signal's points, or **Start a chat** to write your own message. They see it in a bubble and reply from it.
8. Below: hot visitors today (and whether someone acted), the signals of the last 24 hours, and the most viewed cars of the week with prices shown and the car most compared with each. The page refreshes by itself every 15 seconds.

## The signals

Each signal adds points to the booking likelihood. They come from what the visitor does on the site, never from what they type.

- Intent: dates searched again and again, saw the full price, reached the booking form (and which step), came back for the same car on another day, comparing two or three cars, read the cancellation policy, read about the deposit, insurance or requirements, tapped to call, text or WhatsApp us or copied our number, checked delivery, looked through many photos or stayed long on one car.
- Urgency: pickup within 72 hours, weekend or holiday dates, on a phone late at night, came from a city or model page or a "near me" search.
- Value: a weekly or monthly rental, a premium car, SUV or van, adding a driver, asked about young drivers, a business email.
- Hesitation: watching the price (sorted by lowest price, lowered the price limit), left after seeing the price, unsure about the deposit, trouble with a form, the car not free for their dates.
- Context: came from an ad, a past renter, an offer or payment waiting, a game code not used yet, a popular car. The signals of known customers (offer opened, pay page left, change proposal, request stopped, returning visitor, viewing spree) count too.

## Hot visitors and the actions

- When a visitor turns hot, everyone with Live visitors open sees an alert at the top of the page. Turn on desktop alerts in Live chat to get one on your computer too; none come in the quiet hours (11 pm to 7 am). No email is sent.
- A discount code is single use, 10% off the rental charge (at most $75), valid 3 days, one per visitor a week and 10 a day per person. Admins and Sales send them; the code goes in the chat with the message.
- Assign to Sales gives the visitor to the Sales person on shift (or to you if you work Sales) and raises a task with the reasons and the contact when we know who they are.
- Each action shows on the visitor ("Invited by Lena, 2 min ago") so two people do not write to the same visitor.

## Signal settings

1. Open **Today** > **Live visitors** and press **Signal settings**.
2. Score and actions: from how many points a visitor is hot or warm, when a signal is strong or medium, the hot alert, and the discount code (percent, most off a booking, days valid, codes a day per person, whether customer service may send codes, and the message).
3. Each signal: on or off, its points, its thresholds (for example 72 hours for "Pickup soon", 3 searches for "Searching dates again and again"), the suggested action and the message. {car}, {days}, {pickup} and the other words in braces are filled in from the visit.
4. Press **Save the signals**. The next look at each visit uses them.

## Follow-up tasks

Signals of known visitors become tasks with a suggested action, for example "Call or message Maya Chen: opened offer CC-1042 twice, no answer for 6 hours".

- An offer opened and not answered: after 6 hours, to Sales when the booking is credited to someone in Sales, otherwise customer service.
- The pay page left without paying: after 30 minutes, customer service. The change proposal opened twice: customer service.
- A booking request started and stopped, or a viewing spree, by a known visitor: Sales.
- A task closes by itself when the renter answers the offer, pays or answers the proposal. Each signal raises one task only.
- The thresholds are in **Settings** > **Program**, group "Live visitors and live chat", with how long "on the site now" lasts (5 minutes) and how often an open page says it is still there (45 seconds). Follow-ups done count in My sales.

## Recovery emails

Known renters who stop before finishing get one polite reminder, and at most one more a day later.

- An offer opened and not answered: after 4 hours. The pay page left without paying: after an hour. A change proposal opened and not answered: after 4 hours.
- A booking request started and not sent: after 2 hours, and only to renters who agreed to hear from us (marketing consent).
- Sent only between 9:00 and 21:00 Toronto time, never to someone who unsubscribed, and never while a staff member is handling the renter (a task they took, a chat with a person, a message from staff).
- They stop as soon as the renter answers, pays or sends the request; a reminder still waiting is not sent. The delays and hours are in Program settings, "Booking recovery emails".

## Interest in a car

**Cars** > **Vehicles**, a car, Overview: "Interest on the site" shows who is looking now, views today and in 7 days, the people who saw the price for their dates, conversion over 30 days (requests from the people who viewed it), the cars most often compared with it, and the last 14 days. The Vehicles list has "Most viewed cars this week".

## A renter's visits

On a renter's page (People > Renters, the name) and on a booking's History tab, "On the site" lists when they viewed the offer, opened the change proposal, viewed or left the pay page, which cars they looked at, and their chats.

## Live chat

1. A visitor who asks for a person is a line on To do, marked Now: press **Open the chat**. Or open **Bookings** > **Live chat**. The menu counts chats waiting for a person. Open chats come first, those waiting for a person on top, with their minutes against the first reply target (5 minutes).
2. Choose a conversation. Beside it you see the visitor's page, pages, signals, and the renter with their bookings when known.
3. Press **Take over**: the assistant stops and the visitor reads that you joined. Writing a reply also takes over. Press **Send** (or Enter).
4. **Hand back to the assistant** lets it answer again. **Close** ends the chat; if the visitor gave an email they get a copy. **Email the transcript** sends it any time.
5. Notify me: "Email me when a chat waits (while I am on shift)" and desktop alerts in this browser. You are on shift while Live chat or Live visitors is open.

> Tip: The assistant only repeats prices from our pricing (a quote or the car's rates), never offers discounts or promises a car, never talks about insurance and never names a provider. Each reply it was not allowed to send says so in the conversation. When nobody is on shift, the chat asks for the visitor's name, email or phone and raises a task. A booking from a chat you handled is credited only when you choose "I sourced this client" on the quote or offer.

## The assistant's settings

In Program settings, "Live visitors and live chat": the chat on or off, the AI first or not, its model, the neurons it may use a day (6,000, about 10 chats; then chats wait for a person), the greeting on car pages after some seconds (off by default), how long chats and visits are kept, as the privacy policy says: chats 12 months, the pages of a visit 90 days, the visit's summary in Visitor history 13 months, and the daily totals, which name no one, 3 years.

## What a visitor typed

A visitor who typed contact details into a form shows them on their line: "Typed into the booking request, not sent: Maya Chen, maya@example.com", with **Email not confirmed** until they open the link we emailed, and **Renter page**.

sections.title: Texts and calls (the Quo phone line)
sections.blurb: Texts and calls in the chat inbox, unknown callers, missed calls, booking texts, call summaries and the settings.
sections.body_md:
Every call and text on the CarmaCars number (Quo) is kept and matched to the person: staff, a renter and their booking, an owner or a lead. Staff answer texts from the same inbox as live chat. It is on by default; Program settings switch each part.

## The inbox

1. Open **Bookings** > **Live chat** and press **Texts and calls**. Each number shows who it is (Renter, Owner, Lead, Staff or Unknown caller), unread texts and missed calls.
2. Choose a number. Calls and texts are in order; a call shows its length, and Quo's summary or a one-line AI summary when there is one.
3. Write a text and press **Send text**: it goes from the CarmaCars number through Quo. **Suggest a reply** puts an AI draft in the box; nothing is ever sent until you press Send text.
4. Beside the conversation: the renter with their bookings, the owner or the lead. A caller who gave the same phone in live chat or a discount game shows their visit on the site.
5. **Stop texts** stops every text to the number, booking texts included. A person who texts STOP is stopped the same way; START allows texts again.

## Unknown callers

Press **Unknown callers**. For a number nobody on file has, type the name if you know it and press **Create lead**, or find the renter and press **Link to** the name. The calls and texts so far follow the link. **Match automatically again** undoes a link made by hand.

## Missed calls

A missed call raises the task "Missed call from ..." for the person on duty in customer service (whoever has Live chat or Texts and calls open), otherwise the customer service queue, and the Admins when nobody holds that function. In the quiet hours (11 pm to 7 am) the task is due at 7 am. One open task per number.

> Tip: Quo itself texts back missed callers (its own auto-reply). The platform can do it instead (Program settings, "Missed call: text the caller back"), once per number in 12 hours: turn off Quo's own auto-reply first, or callers get two texts.

## Calls and texts on records

A booking's History tab, a renter's page and an owner's page have "Calls and texts": the texts, calls, missed calls, voicemails and summaries with that person. Calls are not recorded on the line for now, so there is no transcript or recording to show.

## Booking texts

Since October 22, 2026 these are text alerts: each person chooses Email, Text or Both (the chapter Text alerts, below, and **Settings** > **All settings**, **Text alerts**).

## The settings

Program settings, "Phone and texts (Quo)": the line on or off, calls and texts kept, the missed-call text and its task, who calls back, AI suggestions and summaries with their daily neurons, the visit of a caller, and how long calls and texts of people who are not customers are kept (12 months).

sections.title: Text alerts: email, text or both
sections.blurb: Each person's channel, what is always emailed, STOP and START, quiet hours, US numbers, the texts and the daily count.
sections.body_md:
Every renter, owner, investor and staff member chooses how we reach them: Email, Text or Both. Texts go only to a phone they verified with a code, from the CarmaCars number, and each has a link to the page. It is on by default; nothing needs setting up.

## Who gets what

- **Email**: emails only. **Text**: a short text instead of the email. **Both**: a text and the email.
- Not chosen yet: Both for someone with a verified phone and an email, Text for an account made by phone without an email, otherwise Email.
- No verified phone, a number that replied STOP, a US number while US texting waits for A2P 10DLC, or a number outside Canada and the US: email only.
- Signed agreements, statements, receipts, invoices and notices are always emailed when there is an email address. Someone on Text also gets a text with a link to view or download it in their portal.
- Every customer email has its own short text: renters, owners, investors, additional drivers, co-signers and leads. Only the sign-in and security emails (password reset, sign-in link, security notice, "Continue your request") are never texts. A review request or a come-back offer is texted only when its email may go (marketing consent).
- An additional driver's or a co-signer's link is texted to that person (their own account with a verified phone), never to the renter or owner.

## A person's channel

Open the renter, owner or investor under People. The card **How we reach them** shows what they chose, what is used now and why, their verified phone, texts in the last 30 days and any STOP or START. Press **Change** to set it (recorded in the audit log). Customer service and Sales can change a renter's or owner's; an investor's only Admins.

## STOP, START and quiet hours

- A reply STOP (or OPT OUT, UNSUBSCRIBE, CANCEL, END, QUIT) stops texts to the number at once; texts waiting are not sent and their emails go instead. START turns texts back on. Every STOP and START is logged.
- Quo sends no confirmation, so we do: one text right away (quiet hours do not apply), "CarmaCars: you're unsubscribed and won't get more texts. Reply START to resubscribe." after STOP, and "CarmaCars: texts are back on. Reply STOP to opt out." after START. Once per change; the card How we reach them shows it as confirmed by text. A STOP or START you set by hand, or a carrier block, sends nothing.
- The first automated text to a number, and the first after START, ends "Reply STOP to opt out."
- Quiet hours, 9 pm to 8 am Toronto time: texts that are not urgent wait and go at 8 am. Urgent: late return notices, pickup and return details on the day, breakdown, accident and a disabled car.
- A text that is not sent after all (STOP, Quo refuses it, the person chose email meanwhile) sends the email it replaced.

## The settings and the texts

**Settings** > **All settings**, **Text alerts**: on or off, the defaults, the quiet hours, the STOP line, US numbers, and the text of each notification with a preview (edit, switch off, mark urgent). A text names CarmaCars, keeps {{link}}, has no long dash and is at most 320 characters; 160 is one text. The two confirmation texts (after STOP and START) are in the same settings. The generic text built from the email's subject is only for an email added later without its own text.

## Texts a day

Site health on **To do** has **Texts today**: sent, notifications among them, failed, not sent and sign-in codes for the last 7 days, and the texts waiting for 8 am.

sections.title: Discount games and leads
sections.blurb: The giveaway game, the code it sends, game leads to call, and the report.
sections.body_md:
Visitors who are not signed in and browse a few cars get one quick game: spin the wheel, scratch to reveal, quick blackjack, cup shuffle or Plinko. Every play wins a promo code. To see the code they give a first name and an email (a mobile number is optional), so you get a lead. It is on by default; nothing needs setting up.

## What the visitor sees

- After 2 car pages, or 60 seconds on the site, or (on a computer) when the mouse heads for the tabs. A card slides in at the bottom; on a phone it is a sheet at the bottom, never a full-screen block, and it always closes.
- Never for someone signed in or already known by email, never on booking, pay, sign or sign-in pages, never on the first page of a visit from a search engine on a phone, never over the cookie banner. After closing it, not again for 14 days; after claiming, never again.
- Every play wins: 5% off (70 in 100), 10% off (25), 15% off (4) or $50 off a rental of 3 days or more (1). The prize is decided before the game starts; the game only shows it. The short terms with the game list the prizes and say the chances differ.
- The code (for example WIN-7KQ4-XM2P) comes off the rental charge only, up to $75 for a percentage, on one booking, within 7 days, one per person, email, phone and device, never with another code. The email with the code goes either way; a reminder goes 3 days before its last day and another the day before (Promo codes). Offers only with the marketing box ticked.
- On this device the code fills itself into the promo code box of the request form. Like every promo code, the discount is shared with the owner in the split.

## Leads

**Bookings** > **Renter leads**.

1. The tiles: plays, claims, codes on booking requests, bookings, revenue and discounts from game codes in the last 30 days, then the same by game and by prize.
2. Each claim: when, the name (and "on the site now"), email and phone, the prize and game, the code and whether it is used (with the booking), marketing consent, and the visit: cars and pages viewed, minutes, city and device.
3. Press **Call** or **Email**, then **Contacted** (it is yours). **Close** with a reason when there is nothing more to do. A booking with the code marks the lead converted by itself.
4. A visitor who viewed 3 cars or more also gets a Sales task, for example "Claimed 10% off, viewed 6 cars: Maya". It closes when the code goes on a request.

## Contact details typed into forms

**Bookings** > **Renter leads**, the card "Typed into forms" at the top.

1. When someone types a name, email or phone into the request to book, the contact form, List your car, the owner application, Create an account, the discount game or the chat, it is saved as soon as each field is valid, even if they never press Send.
2. Each line: when, the name (and "On the site now"), email and phone, the form, and Sent or Not sent. "Email not confirmed" means the account was opened from the form and the person has not opened the link we emailed them yet.
3. After 30 minutes without sending, To do shows "Unfinished request from Maya Chen: follow up" (not raised from 23:00 to 07:00, the quiet hours of the site alerts). Call or email them; the task closes by itself when they send the form.
4. Only what they typed is saved, and never used for offers without their consent.

> Good to know: A new email gets an account at once (no password, email not confirmed) and one email "Continue your request" 30 minutes later, between 9:00 and 21:00. Until they open its link they cannot accept an offer, sign, pay or upload documents. An account never confirmed closes after 30 days; the lead stays. It is on by default; the times and the To do are in **Settings** > **Program**, the card "Forms left unfinished".

## Settings

**Settings** > **Discount games**.

- On or off, the cap for percentage codes ($75), how long a code is good for (7 days), when it shows (1 car page, 15 seconds, exit intent), the days a visitor keeps their prize (14), and the cars viewed for a Sales task (3). The reminders before a code ends are under Promo codes.
- After a visitor closes a game, a different one shows on their 2nd page view after the close (any page) or 60 seconds later, whichever first; at most 3 in one visit and 6 a day in one browser. All four are settings. Never on booking, payment or signing pages; the request-to-book form has its own game.
- Prizes and games: each prize with its percent or dollars, a minimum rental length and its chance; each game's weight (0 turns it off). Press **Save prizes and games**. Codes already sent keep their value.

sections.title: Referral partners and RentalCoverage
sections.blurb: Body shops and tow trucks that send renters: sign-ups, links and flyers, earnings and payments; and the optional RentalCoverage link.
sections.body_md:
Body shops and tow truck companies (and, if you want, dealerships and insurance brokers) can send you renters and earn a kickback when the rental is finished and paid in full. A separate switch adds an optional affiliate link to RentalCoverage on the pages that talk about coverage. Nothing in either program is shown to renters until you set it up.

## Add a partner

**People** > **Referral partners**, then **Add a partner**.

1. Choose the kind (body shop, tow truck company, dealership or insurance broker) and type the business name, the contact, phone and email. Start typing the address: the city and postal code fill in.
2. Choose how you pay them (e-Transfer, cheque, bank transfer, cash or another way) and, for e-Transfer, the email to pay.
3. Choose the kickback: a flat amount for each completed rental ($50 unless you change it) or a percentage of the rental charge (10% unless you change it). The percentage applies to the rental charge after discounts only, never to add-ons, fees or taxes. The two defaults are under **Settings** > **Program**, Referral partners.
4. Press **Save**. A partner you add is active at once, with a code, a short link and a flyer.

## Approve a sign-up

The public pages carmacars.ca/partners/body-shops and carmacars.ca/partners/tow-trucks have a sign-up form. A sign-up is a pending partner and a task for you; it earns nothing and its code ties no rental until you approve it.

1. Open **People** > **Referral partners**. A sign-up shows as Waiting for approval, and the Partners tab shows how many are waiting.
2. Open the partner and check the business. Press **Approve** (or **Decline**: they are not told by email).
3. Press **Write them their link**. It opens an email to them with their link and code; attach the flyer from the next section before you send it.

## The link, the QR code and the flyer

Open the partner. The card "Link, QR code and flyer" shows everything they hand out.

- The short link is carmacars.ca/r/ and their code, for example carmacars.ca/r/BODY1234. A renter who opens it keeps the partner for 60 days on that device, even if they book later.
- Press **Flyer for the counter (PDF)** for a one-page flyer with their name, their code and a QR code of the link. Print it or send it.
- A renter can also type the code in "Did someone refer you?" on the request to book. A code typed there wins over the link. A code nobody holds is ignored.
- Changing the code ends the old link, QR code and flyer. Pausing or ending a partner stops new rentals from being tied to them; what they already earned stays.

## Rentals you add by hand

**Bookings** > **Add a rental**, field "Referred by (partner code)".

1. Type the partner's code if a body shop or tow truck sent the renter. A code that does not exist or is not active is refused, so a typing mistake shows at once.
2. Forgot it? Open the partner and press **Tie a booking**: enter the booking number and why. This is not possible once a kickback on that booking is approved or paid, nor on a booking that already has an owner or field staff member as its referrer (one referrer per booking: owner, then field staff, then the partner).

## Earnings and payments

**People** > **Referral partners**, the tabs Partners, Kickbacks and Payments made.

1. A kickback starts as "Rental not finished yet". It is earned when the booking is completed and paid in full and no payment is in dispute; it then waits as "Pending approval".
2. Check it on the Kickbacks tab and press **Approve** (or **Approve all** for one partner).
3. Pay the partner the way you agreed, then press **Record a payment** on their line: it settles every approved kickback and keeps the reference.
4. A refund or a lost dispute after the kickback was earned takes it back (a reversal line). If it was already paid, the reversal stays on the ledger as a negative line for you to settle with the partner. Use **Reverse** to take one back yourself, with a reason.

> Good to know: The kickback is a booking expense, taken before the owner's share is worked out, in the same line as staff commissions on the owner statement. Check the owner agreement wording on kickbacks before you start paying partners.

## The partner's own page

The card "Link, QR code and flyer" shows a private page address for the partner. Send it only to them.

- It shows their link and code, their referrals by the customer's first name and the month only, what is waiting and what was paid. No sign-in: the long address is the key.
- Press **New private page link** if it was shared by mistake: the old address stops working at once.

## RentalCoverage affiliate

**Settings** > **RentalCoverage affiliate**. It is off until you join the affiliate program and paste your link.

1. Join RentalCoverage's affiliate program (their affiliate dashboard gives you a tracking link, and sometimes an ID).
2. Press **Paste the affiliate link**. Paste the link exactly as the dashboard gives it. If it has {id} in it, type your ID in the next field and it is filled in. Leave "Show the link on the site" ticked and press **Save**.
3. The link now shows on Requirements and coverage, the credit card coverage guide and the coverage step of the request to book. Each says it is a separate company's optional product, that it does not replace the coverage option the renter chooses, that CarmaCars may earn a commission and that it costs the renter nothing extra. It says nothing about what the product covers.
4. Untick "Show the link on the site" any time to turn it off everywhere.

- Every click goes through a CarmaCars address that counts it by place and month (and by booking when the renter has one) and adds utm_source=carmacars, utm_medium=referral and utm_campaign=coverage_ and the place.
- The page shows clicks by place and month and the latest clicks. RentalCoverage reports the sales, not the site: when they pay you, press **Add a payment received** with the date, amount and reference.

sections.title: Advertising and owner recruitment
sections.blurb: Ad text for each car and channel, posted ads and their update tasks, bookings by channel, social drafts, Meta publishing, owner recruitment and its consent log.
sections.body_md:
Marketing writes the text of every ad from the car's own record, keeps track of where each ad is posted, tells the sales assistants when an ad needs updating, shows which channels bring bookings, drafts the week's Facebook Page and Instagram posts and keeps the consent log for owner recruitment. Nothing is posted by the server: you post by hand, and Facebook Marketplace from the owner's own profile.

## Write an ad

**Marketing** > **Listings**.

1. Choose the car and the channel (Facebook Marketplace, Kijiji, Craigslist, Instagram, Facebook Page or Google Business Profile) and press **Write it**.
2. Copy each part with its button: the title, the price line, the description (or caption), the hashtags and the tracked link. Each shows its length against the channel's limit (a Kijiji title takes 64 characters, Craigslist 70, an Instagram caption 2,200, a Google post 1,500).
3. Add the photos in the order shown: the first is the cover. Open a photo to save it.
4. Post the ad on the site, then press **Mark as posted** and paste its address and the date.

- The text comes from the car's record only: the rates, kilometres, deposit, delivery fee, who may rent it and the car code. A fact the record does not have is left out. No review, rating or claim is added.
- The tracked link opens the car's page with utm_source (the channel), utm_medium and utm_campaign (the car code), so the request counts under that channel.
- A warning shows when the car does not take requests, has no daily rate, or shows sample photos (take real photos first: an ad shows the car itself).
- Facebook Marketplace is posted from the owner's own Facebook profile in their browser: Meta does not take vehicle listings from business Pages. Kijiji takes one ad per car, in one category and one region. An Instagram caption cannot hold a working link: put it in the bio or a story link sticker.

## When an ad needs updating

**Marketing** > **Posted ads**, or the task in **Today** > **Staff tasks**.

1. A change of 3% or more in a car's daily, weekend, weekly or 30-day rate, any change of its deposit, kilometres, extra-km price or delivery fee, or the car leaving the site marks each of its live ads Needs updating and opens a task for the sales assistants (for example Update the Kijiji ad and the car). The task says what changed, the new price line and the ad's address.
2. Press **New text**, copy the new text and update the ad on the site.
3. Press **Mark the ad updated**. The task closes. Closing the task in Staff tasks counts too.
4. Car off the site: take the ad down and press **Taken down**. If the car comes back at the same rates first, the task is cancelled by itself.

> Good to know: The 3% is under **Settings** > **Program**, Advertising and owner recruitment. The rates are checked again every 6 hours, so a rate dated ahead is caught on its day.

## Bookings by channel

**Marketing** > **Bookings by channel**.

- Every request of the dates chosen counts once: under the source staff set on the booking, else the renter's visit (the campaign source of a tracked link, or the site they came from), else a referral code, else how it reached us (phone, email, WhatsApp).
- Choose the last visit before the request or the first visit. A booking is a request that was confirmed, paid or completed; revenue is its rental charge after discounts. The months add up to the Bookings list.
- The visit is kept with the request when it is sent, so the source outlives the 90 days of visit history. A visitor who refused analytics cookies has no source.
- On a booking, the line Came from shows the source. Press **Set** to give it by hand when the renter told you (a Kijiji reply, a walk-in, word of mouth).

## Facebook Page and Instagram drafts

**Marketing** > **Social drafts**.

1. The week's drafts are written from the fleet every 6 hours, for this week and the next: Monday a new car (published in the last 14 days) or a featured one; Tuesday the owner program; Thursday the cars free this weekend; Friday the requirements (Instagram); Sunday a price highlight or a seasonal trip (Facebook Page). Press **Write drafts for this week** to write them now.
2. Read each draft. Press **Edit** to change the caption, the channels or the day, then **Approve**; or press **Skip**.
3. Copy the caption for each channel (on the Facebook Page the tracked link is in the text; for Instagram copy the link for the bio), post it with the photos shown, then press **Posted on Instagram** or **Posted on Facebook Page** and paste the post's address.

- Wednesday's walkaround video and Saturday's handover story are filmed by field staff. No renter is shown without written consent.
- Press **Add a post of your own** at the bottom of the week for anything else.

## Meta publishing (off until set up)

**Settings** > **Meta publishing**. Until it is on, every post is copied and posted by hand.

1. Make the Instagram account a professional account and link it to the CarmaCars Facebook Page.
2. At developers.facebook.com, create a Business app owned by the CarmaCars business portfolio. Give it the permissions pages_show_list, pages_read_engagement, pages_manage_posts, instagram_basic and instagram_content_publish, and make a long-lived Page access token. Meta may ask for App Review before posts are public.
3. Press **Enter the details**: the Page id, the Instagram account id and the token. The token goes to the vault; the page shows only its last four characters.
4. Press **Switch on**. Approved drafts then go out on their day and their post links are recorded; a refusal shows on the draft. Press **Switch off** or **Remove the token** at any time.

## Owner recruitment

**Marketing** > **Owner recruitment**.

Owners and co-hosts are found in classified ads. The anti-spam law (CASL) does not cover a live phone call, but an email or a text needs consent, names the sender and offers an unsubscribe. The lawyer confirms the approach before outreach starts.

1. Press **Add a lead**: paste the ad's address, choose who is selling (a private seller, a dealer or a rental business) and type the name, the phone and the car from the ad. Nothing is collected from the classified site.
2. Call them with the script on the lead's page and press **Log the call**. A yes needs their words ("Yes, text me the details"): they become express consent in the log. A no means do not contact, ever.
3. When the lead's page says email or text is allowed, choose a template, check the words and press **Send**. The email adds CarmaCars' name, mailing address and the unsubscribe link; the text ends with "Reply STOP to opt out." Texts wait for 8 am during quiet hours.

- Press **Record consent** for consent given another way: express (with its proof), implied by their inquiry (6 months), implied by a business relationship (2 years), a business address published with no "no solicitation" note (never a private seller), or one message after a referral (naming the referrer).
- The consent log is never edited: a change is a new line. An unsubscribe or a STOP reply adds a withdrawal by itself, and nothing more goes on that channel.
- A message without consent is refused with the reason. **Settings** > **Program** has a switch that stops all recruitment messages.

> Watch out: Keep the proof of an oral yes: a recording, or a note written during the call with the time. Consent you cannot show does not count.

sections.title: Search: car pages, landing pages and guides
sections.blurb: Car copy written by itself, landing pages, place pages for every place and term, detailing and body shop, guides, business listings and IndexNow.
sections.body_md:
The text of every car page, the landing pages for each area and way of renting, and the guides are written every day by a scheduled Claude session from the facts in the database, checked with the site's own checks and published by themselves (the website's Workers AI writer is off, so the free AI allowance stays with the staff assistant). Nobody has to type or review anything. You can still change any line; what you change is kept.

## The copy of a car

**Cars** > **Vehicles**, then the car, then its Listing tab. The same card is on the listing review.

1. The card says who wrote the text: a plain copy from the car's facts while the written copy is prepared (the next daily batch), then the batch (claude-batch) or Workers AI.
2. Every field is shown: search title and description, heading, introduction, highlights, good for, what's included, pickup and delivery, requirements, questions and the photo descriptions.
3. To change a field press **Change**, then **Save and lock**. A locked field is kept by every new version. **Unlock** lets it be written again.
4. **Write again** asks for a new version now. A new version is also written by itself when the car's facts change: its rates, specs, area or photos.

> Good to know: The checks refuse long dashes, sales words, the numbered company, any number that is not in the car's facts (a price, a seat count) and equipment the facts do not list. A version that fails is asked again with the problems named; if it still fails, the page keeps its current text and it is tried again later.

## Landing pages and guides

**Settings** > **All settings**, then Search.

1. Today: the Workers AI used for search copy and in all, and IndexNow (addresses waiting and sent).
2. Car copy: every real car, who wrote its text, and whether its facts changed since.
3. Landing pages: each place and way of renting, whether it is in search, its cars and who wrote it. A page for a way of renting (monthly, SUV) goes into search once enough real cars match it (Program settings).
4. Open **Edit** on a page or a guide to change its text. Edited fields are locked. **Write again** asks for a new version; on a guide, the brief says what it must cover.

## Vehicle pages

**Settings** > **Vehicle pages**. A page for every make, model, model year and Canadian trim of every year, at carmacars.ca/cars/make/model/year/trim, with our cars below it; each trim also in every place and in 12 colours (a black 2020 Volkswagen Jetta Sportline in Mississauga, for example); every page again for sale (carmacars.ca/buy/...) and for each search term: renting (car hire), sale (financing), detailing (ceramic coating) and body shop (bumper repair), at carmacars.ca/t/term/...

1. Pages: how many pages each level and each tier has, the total, and how many are in search. Every page is in search by default; nothing needs setting up.
2. One switch per tier takes it out of search at once: **Index the place pages**, **Index the colour pages**, **Index the search term pages**, **Index the /buy pages**, **Index the detailing pages**, **Index the body shop pages**. Off, those pages stay visible but leave the sitemaps and search.
3. The places are the place list of the local search release (every city, town and neighbourhood, with GTA and country levels); until it is filled, the area landing pages. The search terms are edited with them.
4. **Financing disclaimer**: the text on financing and leasing pages. CarmaCars never says it lends or leases.
5. Database: its size against the cap the catalog and places imports keep under: the cap of the Database plan (Pro, 6,144 MB, by default; Free, 450 MB). IndexNow: the addresses sent today, where the sweep is, and any back-off; nothing to do.
6. Each page is built from data: the EPA fuel-use ratings in litres per 100 km, the cost to drive 100 km at the gas or electricity price set here, what changed from the year before, how a trim differs from the others, similar models, and the rental questions from the program settings.
7. Below the facts: our cars of that exact year, model and trim, then the same model in other years, then similar cars free now, and Request it, which sends an enquiry to Bookings > Leads.
8. Settings: **Index every page** (the default) or **Only pages that pass the rules**: makes, models with 2 or more years of data, years with one of our cars or of a popular model from 2015, trims with one of our cars. The others stay visible but out of search. Also the gas, premium and electricity prices, and how often the catalog is imported (every 30 days).
9. Canadian trims: open a model and type one line per run of years, entry trim first: 2020-2021: Comfortline, Highline, Sportline, Execline. Your lines are kept by every import; empty them to go back to the CarmaCars list. **Add trims for another model** adds a model that has none.
10. Catalog import: the last import and its counts. **Import now** asks for a new one; it runs at the next daily check, at 07:17 UTC.

> Good to know: A car joins its pages by itself once it is on the site: its make, model, year and trim are read from the car. A trim that names several (S / SE / R-Line) leaves the car on the year page only; set the car's trim to one Canadian name to put it on the trim page.

## Stock photos on the vehicle pages

**Settings** > **Vehicle pages**, card Stock photos. The vehicle pages show a real photo of the make, model and generation at the top (a 2015 Camry page shows a Camry of the 2012 to 2017 generation), with the credit always under it: "Photo: author, licence, Wikimedia Commons". The place pages and the detailing and body shop pages show a photo of a road, a car being detailed or a body shop. Our own cars always show their own photos.

1. Nothing to set up: the photos come by themselves every day, our fleet's models and the popular models first. Only free licences are used (public domain, CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA), from Wikimedia Commons, or Openverse when Commons has none. A year without a photo of its own generation shows the nearest photo of the model, marked "not the exact year"; a model with no photo keeps the studio drawing.
2. The card shows how many models and model years have a photo, the popular models still without one, and the last run.
3. Open a make to see its photos. A wrong car, a poor photo or a photo you do not want: press **Hide**. The page goes back to the studio drawing at once, and that photo is never picked again.
4. **Pick again** asks for the next best photo; **Replace** takes a photo you found on Wikimedia Commons: paste its address (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:...). Either is done at the next daily run, after its licence is checked. A photo whose licence is not allowed is refused, with the reason.
5. **Show stock photos** in the settings above turns every stock photo off at once (on by default).

> Good to know: Never upload or use a photo from Google, a dealer or a manufacturer's site here: only Wikimedia Commons files, with the credit the page shows.

## A car for sale

**Cars** > **Vehicles**, then the car. On the For sale card, tick **For sale**, enter the Asking price and press **Save**.

1. The car then shows at the top of its /buy pages (its make, model, year and trim) with the asking price, the only time a page says a car is for sale.
2. Untick it when the car is sold or no longer for sale: the pages say so at once.
3. "Find me this car" on the /buy pages sends a buyer lead to Sales (staff portal: **Owner leads**, Buyer leads), with a To do line.

## Search engines and business listings

**Settings** > **All settings**, then Site settings.

1. Search engines: paste the Google Search Console value (HTML tag) or the file name (HTML file), and the Bing value. The steps are on the card.
2. Business name, address and phone: the exact text for every listing, and the description and categories.
3. Business listings: press **Copy** beside each line and paste it into Google Business Profile, Bing Places, Apple Business Connect, Yelp, Yellow Pages and Facebook. Tick each one when it is done.

> Good to know: Changed pages are sent to IndexNow (Bing and the other engines that use it) by themselves. Google reads the sitemap: submit carmacars.ca/sitemap.xml once in Search Console.

## Place pages

Every place we have, from a country down to a neighbourhood, gets a page for every term people search with: renting (car hire, SUV rental, monthly car rental ...), buying help (used cars, car financing ...), detailing (ceramic coating, window tint ...) and body work (collision repair, dent repair ...). Each page is written from real data only: the distance from us, the delivery price within our reach, the nearest airport, the landmarks near it, our live cars and the places around it. A place far from Toronto says we serve the Toronto area and takes a request instead. **Settings** > **All settings**, then Search.

1. Place pages: four switches, one for each family, put the pages in search and in the sitemaps. All four are on.
2. Quality gate: off. On, only places within the delivery reach are in search, and rental pages only with a real matching car. Search engines can treat many similar pages as low value; the gate lowers that risk.
3. Delivery reach: places within this distance of our location are offered delivery. Database size cap: the places import stops before the database passes it.
4. Regions and places: every province, state and territory is on. Untick a region to take its pages and sitemaps off the site.
